subject: Expansion boost: temporary trial credit request & onboarding milestones
messages:
From: Linda Park <linda@nebulahq.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: SeedLoom Accelerator <program@seedloom.org>
Date: 2026-09-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: short extension + promo credits for our accelerator demo run

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the intro call this morning — Nebula Health has been making good progress integrating Redwood for our clinical notes summarization pilot. The SeedLoom team recommended we reach back out around credits and staging: our usage spiked during a private demo week and knocked us against the trial cap.

Two asks:
- Would Redwood consider a one-month trial extension + a $25k promo credit to complete the accelerator demo and collect clinician feedback?
- We can agree to a short mutual action plan (three milestones) tied to usage/engagement if that helps approvals.

Attached is a quick utilization snapshot (usage_report_q3.csv) and a draft onboarding milestones doc. We're a small team (3 engineers, 1 clinical lead) and the extension would materially affect our ability to evaluate for a paid rollout.

Appreciate any flexibility — happy to hop on a quick call.

Best,
Linda Park
Founder & CTO, Nebula Health
[Attachment: usage_report_q3.csv]
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Linda Park <linda@nebulahq.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + promo credits for our accelerator demo run

Hi Linda — thanks for the details and the snapshot. Congrats on getting the demo week traction.

Looping in Monica (CS) and Aditya (sales) to scope an operational path. High-level note on constraints: credit approvals > $10k need finance/manager sign-off; accelerator referrals sometimes qualify for a promotional exception if tied to clear onboarding milestones and a short evaluation window.

Proposed next steps:
1) Monica: propose a 4-week credit + milestone plan and a recommended credit amount (we can escalate if > $10k).
2) Linda: confirm the 3 milestones you can commit to (we can reuse your doc).
3) Aditya/Hannah: handle approvals and finalize terms + simple DocuSign.

If agreeable I can schedule a 20-min sync today to finalize milestones and get the request queued.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Startup Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Linda Park <linda@nebulahq.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + promo credits for our accelerator demo run

Thanks Hannah — 

I reviewed Linda's usage file and the proposed milestones draft. Recommendation:
- Offer a 30-day extension with a $20,000 promotional credit (covers projected tokens for 4-week demo + buffer).
- Milestones to include: 1) Integration smoke tests complete (week 1), 2) Clinician feedback loop + 100 annotated examples (week 3), 3) Post-demo metrics report and decision checkpoint (week 4).

Reasoning: $20k keeps us within the promo band that's approvable by Partnerships leadership; anything > $20k will need finance manager (Laura) sign-off and legal review for a revised promo addendum.

I've attached a short proposed terms PDF (proposed_credit_terms.pdf) and a Milestones doc (nebulahq-onboarding-milestones.docx) with dates filled.

Linda — if you confirm those milestones I will submit the credit request to Ops and draft a one-page mutual action plan for signatures.

Quick Q for the team: is a usage-based cap required on the credit or do we set it as a flat credit and monitor? I propose flat credit with automatic throttling if usage exceeds a safety threshold; we can implement a hard cap if Finance asks.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: proposed_credit_terms.pdf, nebulahq-onboarding-milestones.docx]
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Linda Park <linda@nebulahq.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T14:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + promo credits for our accelerator demo run

Monica — thanks for the clear recommendation. Approved from Sales/Partnerships side for the 30-day extension + $20,000 promo credit on the conditions Monica outlined.

Operational asks before we push to Ops/Finance:
- Linda: confirm the milestone dates in the attached doc (or tell us tweaks).
- Monica: include the flat-credit with a hard safety cap (I suggest $28k absolute throttle) in the Ops request; if Finance asks we can loop Laura for sign-off.
- Hannah: please route the Ops ticket (and cc Aditya) after we have Linda's confirmation; I'll draft the short email to the SeedLoom contact to note the approved sponsorship.

Linda — excited to see Nebula's clinician results. If you want to jump on a 20-min sync tomorrow morning to confirm dates, I can make time.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Approval note: Sales/Partnerships approved $20,000 promo credit; pending Ops ticket for execution]
